description: Large uniform random decoded-gene pool followed by random sampling within precomputed complexity strata. Complexity strata are defined with the quantile strategy. No PSNR, predicted PSNR, training result, or zero-cost score is used for architecture selection.
descriptor_notes: Descriptor matrix is 26-dimensional: op/kernel/repeat counts, channels, and log estimated complexity.
Descriptor standardization for selection distances is computed once on the full pool.
selection_min_distance is nearest-neighbor distance among the selected 50 in the pool-standardized descriptor space.
selection_min_distance_raw is the max-min draw distance in the same pool-standardized space when max-min selection is used; it is empty for stratified_random.
PCA is not used for selection and no performance label is used.
extra_eval_convention: RGB/full-image PSNR and SSIM with images normalized to [0, 1], HR cropped to dimensions divisible by scale, LR generated by TensorFlow resize using bicubic by default, and no border shaving. This matches the trainer metric convention more closely than Y-channel benchmark protocols.
reference_usage: overlap reporting only; references are not used in sampling
training_stopping_policy: Full training uses the repository trainer callbacks. The epoch value is only a maximum cap; EarlyStopping monitors validation PSNR and restores the best weights.
